items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Eppie Jackson out of Muskogee, I say well I'd forgot all of that.

ctx.x: Yeah. She says oh yeah. She says how did that come about? I say well they were the two stars for the label. And behind that they were able to make enough money to put up the towers. She say well, I never knew that before, she say I passed that place a many time and wondered what it was. (Laughter). Because I had her home boneing up trying to remember these two bands out of Muskogee that she had Coleman Hawkins' name down for me. Eppie Jackson out of Muskogee, I say well I'd forgot all of that. Well you do…
me when I got home. Trying to help.
